Questions

Is this real money?

Yes. When you are signed in you play with your wallet balance, which you fund with crypto and can withdraw. Items can be sold back for their listed value or shipped to you. Free demo spins keep nothing. You must be 18 or older. Please play responsibly.

How do I know it is fair?

Each result comes from a seed that is hashed before you open and revealed after. The verify button recomputes it so you can compare.

Where is my progress saved?

Only in this browser. Your dashboard has a reset button if you want to start over.
